SafeMath multiplication with overflow assert.
SafeMath division.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assert.
SafeMath addition with overflow assert.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, payment recipient and access control.
now/block.timestamp used in size growth calculations and indirectly in blockhash randomness.
oldOwner.transfer(payment) in buy sends ether to an arbitrary address before state is fully settled.
msg.sender.transfer(purchaseExcess) in buy refunds excess ether to the caller.
contractOwner.transfer(this.balance) in contractWithdraw drains all contract funds.
Unsigned uint8 arithmetic combining piranha.size with (now-growthStartTime)/300, vulnerable to truncation/overflow.
Pseudo-randomness derived from block.blockhash(block.number-1) and timestamp in breeding, predictable by miners.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to contractOwner.
buy sets newOwner from msg.sender.
buy reads the previous owner into oldOwner.
Payment recipient address originates from oldOwner and is used in an external transfer.
Excess refund is sent to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
contractWithdraw sends the whole balance to the stored contractOwner.
Timestamp participates in size arithmetic with uint8 truncation.
Timestamp-dependent blockhash is used as a randomness source.
randNum is derived inside breeding from blockhash randomness.
newbornGen is derived from the predictable random number.
newbornUnique rarity is derived from the predictable random number.
maleSize is computed inside breeding from size and time.
femaleSize is computed inside breeding from size and time.
piranhaSize computed with unchecked uint8 arithmetic in bite.
buy uses _tokenId to index piranhas and ownership mapping.
changePiranhaName writes _name into the piranha struct.
ERC721 transfer forwards the recipient parameter _to.
breeding uses _maleTokenId to locate the male piranha.
breeding uses _femaleTokenId to locate the female piranha.
bite uses _victimTokenId to locate the victim piranha.
allPiranhasInfo uses _startPiranhaId as pagination start.
changeBeedingCost stores _newCost into breedingCost.
startSelling stores _price into piranha.sellPrice.
transferContractOwnership writes _newOwner into contractOwner.
buy reads piranha.sellPrice into sellingPrice.
buy computes the 97% payment amount.
buy computes the excess refund amount.
Computed payment flows into the external transfer to oldOwner.
Computed excess flows into the transfer back to msg.sender.
onlyContractOwner gates the write of contractOwner.
Owner-only setter mutates breedingCost.
Owner-only setter mutates biteCost.
startSelling writes piranha.sellPrice in the piranhas array.
stopSelling clears piranha.sellPrice.
changePiranhaName mutates the piranha name.
hungry mutates the hungry flag and size.
notHungry clears the hungry flag.
bite mutates attacker and victim piranha sizes.
breeding mints a new token through _createPiranha.
_createPiranha pushes a new struct into the piranhas array.
buy calls the internal _transfer to move ownership.
ERC721 transfer delegates to _transfer.
_transfer updates piranhaIdToOwner.
_transfer increments/decrements ownershipTokenCount.
Minting performs an initial _transfer from address(0).
contractWithdraw executes the balance transfer to the owner.
buy executes the external payment to the previous owner.
buy executes the excess refund transfer.
breeding computes pseudo-random values from blockhash and timestamp.
External transfer to oldOwner may callback into buy before the transaction completes.
Refund transfer to msg.sender may callback into buy and re-enter.
Full-balance transfer to contractOwner may callback into contractWithdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner is only used as the assignment source in transferContractOwnership.
Parameter _tokenId is only used for indexing inside buy.
Parameter _name is only written into the piranha struct in changePiranhaName.
Parameter _to is only forwarded to _transfer from the ERC721 transfer function.
Parameter _maleTokenId is only used to index the male piranha in breeding.
Parameter _femaleTokenId is only used to index the female piranha in breeding.
Parameter _victimTokenId is only used to index the victim piranha in bite.
Parameter _startPiranhaId is only used as loop start in allPiranhasInfo.
Parameter _newCost is only stored into breedingCost/biteCost by the owner setters.
Parameter _price is only stored into piranha.sellPrice in startSelling.
Local oldOwner is the payment recipient of the external transfer in buy.
Local newOwner is the buyer identity used throughout buy.
Local sellingPrice is a transient read of piranha.sellPrice inside buy.
Local payment is the amount forwarded in the external transfer to oldOwner.
Local purchaseExcess is the amount forwarded in the refund transfer to msg.sender.
Local piranhaSize is the result of the unchecked uint8 size arithmetic.
Local randNum is the pseudo-random seed produced by the unsafe randomness operation.
Local newbornGen is derived from the unsafe pseudo-random number.
Local newbornUnique is derived from the unsafe pseudo-random number.
Local maleSize is a transient computed value inside breeding.
Local femaleSize is a transient computed value inside breeding.
